instruction: Candid athletic photograph, eye-level medium shot. On an outdoor reddish track with green grass behind, the man in the black t-shirt (R1) on the left and the woman in the black and gray long-sleeve top (R2) on the right perform forearm planks facing each other. The man (R1) extends his right arm forward while the woman (R2) extends her left arm, their hands reaching toward each other without touching. Both look at each other attentively. Bright direct sunlight casts sharp shadows on the track.
elements: R1 extends his right arm forward toward R2
R2 extends her left arm forward toward R1
R1 and R2 perform forearm planks facing each other
R1 and R2 reach their hands toward each other without touching
R1 and R2 look at each other attentively
outdoor reddish track with green grass behind
